features.source:
def player_has_reached_upper_corridor(s, a):
    del a
    if not isinstance(s, dict):
        return False
    player = s.get('player')
    switch = s.get('rotation_switch')
    if not player or not switch:
        return False
    py = float(player['center'][1])
    sy = float(switch['center'][1])
    movement_scale = max(float(player['width']), float(player['height']))
    return py <= sy - movement_scale
